---
title: "Gaze_departure_latency"

date: "2026-08-04"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)


df_departure <- read.csv("./Dataframes-used/departure_latency_data.csv")

df_departure$participant <- as.factor(df_departure$participant)
df_departure$cue        <- as.factor(df_departure$condition)
df_departure$position   <- as.factor(df_departure$position)

df_front_EG <- df_departure[df_departure$position == "Front", ]
df_rear_EG  <- df_departure[df_departure$position == "Rear",  ]


# ── General anova ──────────────────────────────────────
m_EG <- lmer(departure_ms ~ cue * nb_dist *position + (1 | participant),
                data = df_departure)
anova(m_EG, type = 2)
effectsize::eta_squared(m_EG)

#front
m_front_EG <- lmer(departure_ms ~ cue * nb_dist + (1 | participant),
                data = df_front_EG)
anova(m_front_EG, type = 2)
effectsize::eta_squared(m_front_EG)

#Rear

m_rear_EG <- lmer(departure_ms ~ cue * nb_dist + (1 | participant),
               data = df_rear_EG)
anova(m_rear_EG, type = 2)
effectsize::eta_squared(m_rear_EG)

# Pairwise distractor comparisons
emmeans(m_rear_EG,  pairwise ~ nb_dist, adjust = "None")
emmeans(m_front_EG,  pairwise ~ nb_dist, adjust = "None")

emmeans(m_EG,  pairwise ~ position, adjust = "None")

```
